content: Good morning, this is Officer Brent McAllister from the IRS Revenue Services, badge number 472981. I'm calling in regards to your federal tax file for the year 2022.
Sorry, did you say IRS? I filed my taxes through a company, I think everything was fine.
Yes sir, your file was flagged during a recent review. Our system shows you may be eligible for the new IRS Tax Debt Relief Program, but there are outstanding balances that must be addressed first.
I wasn't aware I owed anything. What is this relief program about?

It's a limited-time initiative for select taxpayers. If you qualify, a significant portion of your tax liability can be forgiven, but we must process your application immediately to avoid escalated actions against your account.
Escalated actions? What do you mean by that?
Failure to comply could result in a federal lien, wage garnishment, or even legal proceedings. However, if you proceed with the program now, you can avoid all of these.
That sounds serious. I definitely want to avoid any legal issues. What do I need to do?
First, I need to initiate your enrollment. There is a one-time legal preparation fee of $1,050 to secure your eligibility and freeze any further IRS actions.
I have to pay a fee? How do I do that?
Yes, the IRS requires this fee before processing your relief application. To expedite, do you have access to any payment apps such as Zelle, Cash App, or Venmo?
I'm not sure. I have a bank account and a debit card. Is that okay?
Absolutely. For your convenience, the IRS accepts direct transfer. I'll provide you with the secure routing and account number for immediate processing.
Will I get some kind of receipt or confirmation after?
Yes, once the payment is processed, you'll receive an official IRS confirmation email. Can you please confirm when you are ready to initiate the transfer so I can guide you through the process?
I'm ready to do it now if you can give me the details.
Great. Please write down this routing number: 021000021, and the account number: 196543287. Enter the amount of $1,050 and let me know when the transfer is complete.
Okay, I'm entering the details. Just to be sure, this will stop any legal action, right?
Correct. Once payment is received, your file will be marked resolved and you'll be protected from any IRS penalties or enforcement. Please notify me as soon as you complete the transfer.
I've submitted it. How long until I get the email?
